title: Exact Framework PR head has a SonarQube Cloud Critical S5443 security signal in a CRS regression assertion
title_de: Exakter Framework-PR-Head hat ein kritisches SonarQube-Cloud-S5443-Security-Signal in einer CRS-Regressions-Assertion
summary: SonarQube Cloud initially marked Draft PR #27 head 15e9a034 with Critical python:S5443 because a negative CRS regression assertion contained a retired /tmp pathname literal. Source-to-sink validation proved the line only compares checked-in script text and has no filesystem or process sink. Follow-up commit 66d9087 asserts the actual retired predictable `crs-version-pinning.$$` form; exact-head SonarQube Cloud now passes with zero open pull-request vulnerabilities.
summary_de: SonarQube Cloud markierte zunächst den Draft-PR-#27-Head 15e9a034 mit Critical python:S5443, weil eine negative CRS-Regressions-Assertion ein ausgemustertes /tmp-Pathname-Literal enthielt. Die Source-to-Sink-Validierung bewies, dass die Zeile nur eingecheckten Skripttext vergleicht und keinen Filesystem- oder Process-Sink hat. Follow-up-Commit 66d9087 prüft die tatsächlich ausgemusterte vorhersagbare Form `crs-version-pinning.$$`; SonarQube Cloud besteht auf dem Exact-Head jetzt mit null offenen Pull-Request-Vulnerabilities.
observed_behavior: Check 88088009441 failed with `D Security Rating on New Code` and one python:S5443 vulnerability annotation on `self.assertNotIn("/tmp/crs-version-pinning", script)`. Exact final-head check 88089324795 passed; the public Quality Gate API reports Security Rating A and the open-vulnerability query returns total 0.
observed_behavior_de: Check 88088009441 schlug mit `D Security Rating on New Code` und einer python:S5443-Vulnerability-Annotation auf `self.assertNotIn("/tmp/crs-version-pinning", script)` fehl. Der Exact-Final-Head-Check 88089324795 bestand; die öffentliche Quality-Gate-API meldet Security Rating A und die Open-Vulnerability-Abfrage liefert total 0.
expected_behavior: The regression test must prove that the production script does not use the retired predictable path, while no test expression may be misclassified as an unsafe public-directory file operation. The exact remote PR-head SonarQube Quality Gate must pass without suppressing, excluding, disabling, or weakening any control.
expected_behavior_de: Der Regressionstest muss beweisen, dass das Produktionsskript den ausgemusterten vorhersagbaren Pfad nicht verwendet, während kein Testausdruck als unsichere Public-Directory-Dateioperation fehlklassifiziert werden darf. Das exakte Remote-PR-Head-SonarQube-Quality-Gate muss ohne Unterdrückung, Exclusion, Deaktivierung oder Abschwächung eines Controls bestehen.
impact: The scanner signal temporarily caused a required external Quality Gate to fail. It was validated as test-only rather than a product security vulnerability, and a semantics-preserving regression correction restores the exact-head Quality Gate without weakening a control.
impact_de: Das Scanner-Signal ließ ein erforderliches externes Quality Gate vorübergehend fehlschlagen. Es wurde als test-only statt als Produkt-Sicherheitsvulnerabilität validiert, und eine semantikerhaltende Regression-Korrektur stellt das Exact-Head-Quality-Gate ohne Abschwächung eines Controls wieder her.
preconditions: Framework Draft PR #27 is bound to exact final head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23.
The source test and CRS version-pinning script remain available in the Framework worktree.
The task must preserve scanner, quality-gate, regression-test, Parent-boundary, and MRTS read-only controls.
reproduction: rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/commits/15e9a034e929fc56bd77c92d783ca2637042e24e/check-runs --jq '.check_runs[] | select(.name == "SonarCloud Code Analysis")'
root_cause: The Sonar rule matched the retired `/tmp` pathname literal inside a negative unit-test assertion. Source-to-sink validation proves that the assertion only compares already-read checked-in script text and has no writable-directory file-creation, file-open, or subprocess sink; it is therefore not a product security vulnerability.
root_cause_de: Die Sonar-Regel matchte das ausgemusterte `/tmp`-Pathname-Literal innerhalb einer negativen Unit-Test-Assertion. Die Source-to-Sink-Validierung beweist, dass die Assertion nur bereits gelesenen eingecheckten Skripttext vergleicht und keinen Writable-Directory-File-Creation-, File-Open- oder Subprocess-Sink hat; sie ist daher keine Produkt-Sicherheitsvulnerabilität.
proposed_remediation: Implemented the focused source-to-sink validation and replaced the broad pathname-prefix assertion with the exact retired predictable `crs-version-pinning.$$` form. The positive safe-runtime-path and private-mktemp controls remain intact. Local and exact-head remote checks passed without a scanner suppression, workflow change, or Quality Gate change.
proposed_remediation_de: Die fokussierte Source-to-Sink-Validierung wurde implementiert und die breite Pathname-Prefix-Assertion durch die exakte ausgemusterte vorhersagbare Form `crs-version-pinning.$$` ersetzt. Die positiven Safe-Runtime-Path- und Private-mktemp-Controls bleiben intakt. Lokale und Exact-Head-Remote-Checks bestanden ohne Scanner-Suppression, Workflow-Änderung oder Quality-Gate-Änderung.
acceptance_criteria: Source-to-sink validation establishes whether the line-287 signal is reachable as an unsafe writable-directory operation or is test-only.
The test rejects the exact retired `crs-version-pinning.$$` predictable form and still requires the safe private mktemp controls in the production script.
Focused regression and legitimate-control tests pass without a scanner suppression, exclusion, or gate change.
The exact final Draft PR #27 head receives a passing SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate, Security Rating A, and no open pull-request vulnerabilities.
validation_plan: Trace the assertion input from the checked script text to its unittest assertion and confirm the absence of filesystem/process sinks.
Run the focused CRS version-pinning and CI-security test suite plus the normal Framework lint target.
Run the static action/workflow and security checks affected by the refactor.
Push only a normal non-force Framework commit after local evidence, then observe the exact final PR-head SonarQube Cloud and related controls. (Passed at 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23.)
regression_tests: Existing CI security evidence-contract negative and legitimate-control tests
legitimate_control_tests: The current CRS script retains `assert_safe_runtime_path`, private `mktemp`, and NUL-safe path iteration assertions.
The semantic checker continues to accept directly reachable legitimate OSV helper commands.
dependencies: FND-SONAR-0002 remains a separate historical default-branch SonarQube backlog.
FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 and FND-GITHUB-0002 remain separate required-CI delivery blockers.
residual_risk: This test-only signal is fixed on the exact PR head, but the record is not closed before a merged-current-master verification. The final Sonar check retains 17 non-security new issues while Quality Gate, Security, Reliability, and Maintainability ratings pass; the unrelated required-CI blockers remain outside this finding's remediation scope.
residual_risk_de: Dieses Test-only-Signal ist auf dem exakten PR-Head repariert, aber der Record wird vor einer verifizierten gemergten Current-Master-Prüfung nicht geschlossen. Der finale Sonar-Check behält 17 nicht-sicherheitsrelevante New-Issues, während Quality-Gate-, Security-, Reliability- und Maintainability-Ratings bestehen; die nicht zusammenhängenden Required-CI-Blocker bleiben außerhalb des Remediation-Scopes dieses Findings.

history.detail: Exact Draft PR #27 head check 88088009441 reported open Critical python:S5443 with Security Impact High at a negative CRS path assertion. The signal is tracked as a candidate while focused source-to-sink validation and a non-suppressive remediation are planned.

Source-to-sink validation found no file or process sink in the assertion. Follow-up Framework commit 66d9087 preserves the regression with the exact retired predictable form; exact-head Sonar check 88089324795 passed with Security Rating A and zero open pull-request vulnerabilities.
